headline: Clorox Appoints Unilever Executive as New Chief Executive Officer
summary: Clorox has appointed a senior Unilever executive to serve as its new Chief Executive Officer.
why: Executive leadership transitions at major consumer goods companies can signal strategic shifts in operations, cost management, and market positioning.

impacts.name: The Clorox Company
impacts.why: New leadership introduces strategic uncertainty regarding future restructuring, operational focus, and financial performance.
